content:
Democrats continue to refuse to debate their Republican counterparts.

Now, they’re so scared they won’t even walk on stage while a Republican candidate is sitting in the audience. Instead, one candidate had a Republican kicked out of the auditorium before she walked on stage.

The Post Millennial reports, “Under the rules for the taped event, which will air at 7 PM Saturday Arizona time, audience members are not allowed to record video. The candidates were reportedly not supposed to be on the stage simultaneously.”AS CHICAGO BRACES FOR 'ICE INVASION,' DHS SECRETARY NOEM CONFIRMS ITS COMING!

Instead, both candidates were to take the stage at separate times. However, Lake was sitting in the front row instead of in a green room far away from the Democratic candidate, Katie Hobbs. At the sight of Lake, Hobbs refused to take the stage.NYT REPORTER SCOFFS: ZOHRAN MAMDANI’S ‘SOCIALISM’ IS NOTHING MORE THAN TREATING PEOPLE FAIRLY!

NYT REPORTER SCOFFS: ZOHRAN MAMDANI’S ‘SOCIALISM’ IS NOTHING MORE THAN TREATING PEOPLE FAIRLY!

Per The Post Millennial, “According to eyewitness accounts, event moderator León Krauze invited Democratic candidate Hobbs to the stage, but she refused to come out.”

Soon after, Lake received orders to leave the room and wait in her green room. The event moderator, Leon Krauze, listened to Lake plead her case that she wanted an honest debate on the stage, but Krauze had to inform her that it wasn’t possible.DETROIT PRO-PALESTINIAN CONFERENCE SPARKS FURY AFTER SHOCKING CALL TO ‘DESTROY THE IDEA OF AMERICA’

The Post Millennial says Krauze said, “Unfortunately, you’re not going to be able to be on the stage with Miss Hobbs,” he argued. “I cannot invite her to the stage if you are in the audience. This is not me. This is the… the campaign agreement.”DEM REP. RO KHANNA TEASES ‘EXPLOSIVE’ EPSTEIN PRESSER THIS WEEK!

Lake took the opportunity to address the audience and let them know that she’d love to have an honest debate about real issues. However, she had to leave because the only way her Democratic opponent would address the audience was if it didn’t include Kari Lake.CALIFORNIA SCRAMBLES TO DEPLOY SECURITY FOR KAMALA HARRIS!

CALIFORNIA SCRAMBLES TO DEPLOY SECURITY FOR KAMALA HARRIS!

Hobbs claimed the green room was a requirement, while Lake was under the impression it was an option. Per The Post Millennial, “The Hobbs campaign sent NBC a pre-event email from the organizers that said ‘each candidate will have their separate green room to prep and hold before going onto the main stage.’”FLORIDA SLAMS CALIFORNIA OVER DEADLY TRUCKING LOOPHOLES—NEW CRACKDOWN ANNOUNCED AFTER TRAGIC CRASH!

However, “According to the Lake campaign, they did not receive such an email, and they were under the impression that the green room was an amenity, not a requirement.”

Regardless of the rules, anyone who expected the Trump-like Republican to follow the rules has never heard of Kari Lake. She’s bold and ready to make the changes that need to be made, unlike her scared Democratic opponent.
